### A False Promise of Peace
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier.org
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/false-promise-peace
Passage: Jeremiah 8:8-13
Points:
- Unwelcome truth must be confronted before any true healing can occur.
- Judah’s leaders offered a deceptive sense of security instead of declaring God’s reality.
- Acknowledging the bad news of judgment is necessary to seek genuine repentance.
- God issues severe warnings so sinners will turn back to Him before judgment falls.
- Believers must heed biblical warnings rather than assuming they are immune to discipline.
